title: The test suite has room under its id ceiling and its darwin time limit, so a story adds a test of its own instead of merging into another
goal: The test ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json and the darwin time limit leave room for the next sprint's tests (the suite ran 100 of 100 ids in 21.0 to 21.3 s against 22 s through SP-ilje65fa, and four stories merged their tests into one census test id): either the ceiling and limit are raised by an operator gate or the suite is made faster, measured before and after.
notes: Merged from ST-7ibioci3 “Each census and factdiff item check selects its own test, not one combined test whose id carries six selectors” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: the census tests merged into one id because the suite is at 100 of 100 ids and the 24 s ceiling: the problem ST-5zcl2sof already carries; absorb: the six census/factdiff selectors each get their own test once room exists Its goal: census_retry, census_baseline, census_repin, census_github_page, factdiff_learn_git and factdiff_anchor each select a test that exercises only that item's behaviour, within the test ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json (raise it with the operator's gate if the ceiling is what forces the merge), so a passing check proves its own item. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/backlog.py", "selectors"]} Its touches: _tools/test_redact.py, _tools/tests_ceiling.json
